sections.subhead: One Connected System for Finance, Inventory, and Operations, Not Five Disconnected Tools

body.text: Teknoppy builds custom ERP software in Kochi that connects finance, inventory, purchasing, sales and manufacturing in one cloud system. We map your processes first, migrate your existing data, and roll out one module at a time so daily work is not disrupted.

Choosing the right ERP Development Company in Kochi matters because ERP touches every part of your business simultaneously. Unlike generic platforms with rigid templates and escalating per-user monthly licensing fees, our custom ERP platforms are designed around your exact workflows, fully GST-compliant, and 100% owned by your business.

sections.h2: Custom ERP or Off-the-Shelf (Odoo, ERPNext, SAP, Tally)?

items.title: Off-the-Shelf ERP (SAP, Odoo, ERPNext, Tally)
items.text: Off-the-shelf software works well if your operational workflows match standard templates. However, per-user monthly subscription fees compound quickly as your team expands, custom modifications often require expensive specialized consultants, and your team is forced to change its daily routines to fit the software.

items.title: Teknoppy Custom ERP
items.text: A custom ERP is built around your established operational processes, eliminating workaround spreadsheets. You pay zero per-user recurring license fees, enjoy seamless integration with Indian GST and banking gateways, and retain 100% full ownership of your source code and database.

items.title: 1. Business Process Mapping
items.text: We document how finance, inventory, procurement, and operations currently function before writing code, identifying bottlenecks and reconciliation gaps.

items.title: 2. Architecture & Module Scoping
items.text: We define core database models, role permissions, and prioritize modules so high-impact departments go live first.

items.title: 3. Custom Build & Workflow Configuration
items.text: We build custom fields, approval chains, GST logic, and reports tailored directly to your team's real daily tasks.

items.title: 4. Data Migration & System Integration
items.text: We migrate legacy records from spreadsheets, Tally, or legacy software with strict validation before switching.

items.title: 5. Phased Rollout & Team Training
items.text: Implementation happens in phases to minimize operational disruption, backed by hands-on training for each department.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for ERP Development in Kochi

items.html: Phased rollout to prevent operational disruption: ERP touches every department simultaneously. We deploy module-by-module so your daily sales, billing, and dispatch continue uninterrupted.
Indian statutory & GST compliance built in: Automated e-invoices, e-way bills, TDS, PF, ESI, and GSTR export formats tailored specifically for Indian business regulations.
Zero per-seat licensing fees: Own your software outright. Add as many users, warehouse clerks, and department heads as you need without increasing software fees.
Direct collaboration with senior engineers: You work directly with senior architects and developers in Kochi who understand local trade and manufacturing practices.

paragraphs.text: ERP software investment depends on the number of departments, workflow complexity, and legacy data migration needs. Below are our typical price and timeline benchmarks:

paragraphs.html: Core Modular ERP (Single Department / Billing & Inventory): ₹85,000 – ₹1,80,000 (Typical delivery in 8–12 weeks). Ideal for trading, distribution, or growing service firms requiring integrated invoicing, stock tracking, and reporting.

Multi-Department / Enterprise ERP: ₹2,00,000 – ₹5,00,000+ (Rolled out in milestone phases over 12–20 weeks). Designed for manufacturers and large organizations needing integrated production planning, procurement, HR/payroll, and multi-branch finance.
Have specific departmental requirements? Request a custom proposal via our Request a Quote form, calculate costs with our Website Cost Calculator, or Book a Consultation.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — ERP Development Company Kochi

items.q: How much does custom ERP development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Custom ERP development at Teknoppy typically ranges from ₹85,000 to ₹1,80,000 for core modular solutions (8–12 weeks), and ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,00,000+ for comprehensive multi-department platforms spanning manufacturing, HR, and finance (12–20 weeks). Because you own the software outright, there are zero monthly per-user licensing fees.

items.q: How long does it take to implement a custom ERP system?
items.a: Implementation typically takes 8 to 12 weeks for a core single-department or billing-and-inventory module, and 12 to 20 weeks for multi-department systems. We phase the rollout so high-priority modules go live early, ensuring zero disruption to your daily operations.

items.q: Can our custom ERP integrate with Tally and Indian GST portals?
items.a: Yes. We build seamless integrations for automated e-invoicing, e-way bill generation, GSTR reporting, and direct two-way synchronization with Tally Prime or legacy accounting platforms.

items.q: Do we own the ERP source code and data?
items.a: Yes. Upon project completion, you receive full intellectual property ownership of the source code, database architecture, and all business data, with no vendor lock-in or recurring per-seat subscription fees.

items.q: How is ERP different from CRM?
items.a: CRM manages customer relationships, sales pipelines, and lead follow-ups. ERP is broader, unifying finance, inventory, procurement, manufacturing, and HR into one connected system. We can integrate CRM features directly into your custom ERP or connect an existing CRM.

items.q: Will ERP implementation disrupt our daily operations?
items.a: No. We mitigate operational risk by deploying in scheduled phases. Your team tests each module in a staging environment with migrated sample data, and department-specific training is conducted before cutover.
